character_table.brief.md:
Defines mappings between UTF-8 codepoint sequences (characters) and their visual representations (pixmaps).

## Use Cases

- **Character-to-glyph mapping** - Associates text characters, including single utf8 codepoints, ligatures, and grapheme clusters, with their pixmap representation.

brief.constant_code_point_count.md: The exact code point length of all records' `code_points` fields in this table.

flag.use_constant_code_point_count.md: All characters in this table have the same number of code points.

brief.pixmap_tables.md: Pixmap Tables supplying the pixmaps each record may map to.

flag.link_pixmap_tables.md: This table links to any number of Pixmap Tables.

brief.use_advance_x.md: Each record includes an `advance_x` field specifying horizontal pixel advance after rendering.
brief.use_pixmap_index.md: Each record includes a `pixmap_index` field to explicitly reference a pixmap by index.
brief.use_pixmap_table_index.md: Each record includes a `pixmap_table_index` field to specify which linked Pixmap Table to reference.

details.use_advance_x.md: When disabled, the default advance is the pixmap's width. Letter spacing, if any, is added to the advance value.
details.use_pixmap_index.md: When disabled, the pixmap index defaults to match the character record index creating a one to one mapping.
details.use_pixmap_table_index.md: When disabled, the renderer searches linked Pixmap Tables in order until finding a valid pixmap at the character's index. The first pixmap linked will have priority over the last.

brief.advance_x.md: Number of pixels to advance horizontally after rendering this character.
brief.code_points.md: UTF-8 encoded code point sequence, null-terminated unless `constant_code_point_count` is set.
brief.pixmap_index.md: Index of the pixmap within the referenced Pixmap Tables.
brief.pixmap_table_index.md: Index of the specific Pixmap Table to use for this character.

color_table.brief.md:
Stores RGBA color values that can be referenced by pixmap data.

## Use Cases

- **Pixmap palettes** - When linked to a Pixmap Table, provides the color palette for indexed pixel data.
- **Color storage** - Can store color sets independently for other purposes.

brief.constant_alpha.md: The alpha channel value applied to all colors in this table.

flag.use_constant_alpha.md: All colors in this table share the same alpha value.

brief.use_color_type.md: Each record includes a `color_type` field indicating the color mutability type.

details.use_color_type.md: When disabled, the default color type is dynamic. The rendering engine may change the RGBA color to support features such as, but not limited to; text color, and/or palette theming.

brief.custom_alpha.md: Alpha channel value (0 = fully transparent, 255 = fully opaque).

ColorType.Absolute.md: The renderer should render this color exactly as specified, without substitution.
ColorType.Dynamic.md: The renderer may substitute this color to support features such as text color or palette theming.

data_types.ColorType.md: Distinguishes whether a color should be treated as fixed or can be themed and recolored by the renderer.

FontType.Bold.md: The bold-weight variant of a font family.
FontType.Italic.md: The italic or oblique variant of a font family.
FontType.Regular.md: The default, unstyled variant of a font family.

data_types.FontType.md: The typographic style a font represents.
data_types.has_field.md: Non-zero if the corresponding optional field is present; zero if it should be treated as absent (`None`).
data_types.String.md: A null-terminated (\0x00), UTF-8 encoded byte string of any length. Unless otherwise specified.
data_types.u8.md: A single byte representing a number from 0 to 255 unless otherwise specified.
data_types.Vec.md: `u8` length byte followed by that many entries of type `T`. Unless otherwise specified.
data_types.Version.md: Identifies which version of the SimplePixelFont binary layout a file was parsed from or should be serialized as.

errors.conversion_nul_error.md: A Rust string being converted to a C string contained an interior nul byte.
errors.conversion_utf8_error.md: A C string being converted to a Rust string was not valid UTF-8.
errors.invalid_pixmap_data.md: A pixmap's data did not fit the byte layout implied by its width, height, and bits per pixel, or exceeded the maximum value allowed by a compact-encoded partial byte.
errors.invalid_signature.md: The first four bytes did not match the SimplePixelFont file signature.
errors.static_vector_too_large.md: A `Vec` field, such as a table's records or a set of link indexes, held more than 255 entries, which cannot be represented by this format's single-byte length prefixes.
errors.unexpected_end_of_file.md: The byte buffer ended before a complete field, record, or table could be read.
errors.unsupported_color_type.md: A record's color type byte did not correspond to any known `ColorType` variant.
errors.unsupported_font_type.md: A font record's font type byte did not correspond to any known `FontType` variant.
errors.unsupported_table_identifier.md: A table's identifier byte did not correspond to any known table type.
errors.unsupported_version.md: The file's version byte did not correspond to any known `Version` variant.

font_table.brief.md:
Groups Character Tables into named fonts and carries the metadata to identify them.
 
## Use Cases
 
- **Sub-font grouping** - A single file can carry several related fonts, such as Regular, Bold, and Italic, each pointing at its own Character Tables.

brief.character_tables.md: Characters Tables supplying the set of characters each record can include.

flag.link_character_tables.md: This table links to any number of Character Tables.

brief.author.md: Author, manufacturer, or credits for the font.
brief.font_type.md: Style of this font (0 = Regular, 1 = Bold, 2 = Italic).
brief.linked_character_table_indexes.md: Length byte followed by that many Character Table indices this font may access and use.

pixmap_table.brief.md:
Stores glyph data as collections of pixels within pixmaps, representing the visual appearance of a character.

## Use Cases

- **Glyph storage** - Contains the pixmap images for font characters

brief.constant_bits_per_pixel.md: The bits per pixel shared by all pixmaps in this table (only 1-8 supported).
brief.constant_height.md: The height in pixels shared by all pixmaps in this table.
brief.constant_width.md: The width in pixels shared by all pixmaps in this table.

flag.use_constant_bits_per_pixel.md: All pixmaps in this table use the same number of bits to represent a pixel.
flag.use_constant_height.md: All pixmaps in this table share the same height.
flag.use_constant_width.md: All pixmaps in this table share the same width.

brief.color_tables.md: Color Tables supplying the colors each record's pixel values map to in this table.

flag.link_color_tables.md: This table links to any number of Color Tables.

brief.custom_bits_per_pixel.md: Bits used to represent each pixel of this pixmap (only 1-8 supported).
brief.custom_height.md: Height of this pixmap in pixels.
brief.custom_width.md: Width of this pixmap in pixels.
brief.data.md: Packed pixel data as a bit array
